audit.why: Four spikes present: Kayle level 6, Kayle first item, Ornn levels 2-3 (the Brittle setup), Kayle level 16. Out of chronological order in the array but each is correctly placed in time.

audit.whatIsWrong: The knockup setup is described as 'stand near walls for his Q' and 'wall-knockup setup', which inverts the mechanic. No cooldowns are given anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: Volcanic Rupture forms a magma pillar at the end of the fissure, and Searing Charge knocks up only if Ornn collides with terrain while charging. He makes his own wall with Q, then E's into it — the danger is standing near his fresh pillar, not near a lane wall. Numbers: Q 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800 range, W 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, E 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s at 450 range, R 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: State that the pillar is the wall he charges into, give the 9s Q and 450-range E, and key the punish window to the whiffed fissure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: zero cooldown-sequencing lines — every trigger reads 'when Volcanic Rupture is down' with no duration.
audit.why: 9 seconds at rank 1 is a countable window, and it is the ability that enables the knockup, so it is the right one to count.

edits.after: Bellows Breath Brittle detonated by his Searing Charge is a real all-in with a jungler — stay even, don't overstep.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing and Radiant Blast's resist shred are online and his engage is too slow to punish your spacing — you win the farm war here.

edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health on-hit chips him from outside his 450-range Searing Charge.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Fully ranged AoE waves erupt his self-itemized frontline — he has no mobility and no anti-heal to answer it.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — 9s, and its magma pillar is the wall he charges into with E for the knockup. Dodge the fissure line. - Bellows Breath: 10-12s of Brittle. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: focus.text tracks Volcanic Rupture, but by the file's own prose the ability that actually kills Kayle is Bellows Breath's Brittle detonated by Searing Charge — Q is only the wall-maker. Left as-is because focus.text is a champion-level tracking choice, but it is worth a human decision. Also note Ornn's kit carries no anti-heal, so Celestial Blessing sustains his poke freely.
